atoms.exact_source_text: Win Condition - Deferred beyond v0.5.
atoms.normalized_claim: Win Condition is deferred beyond v0.5.

atoms.exact_source_text: v0.5 defines civic and geographic progression but does not define a formal victory trigger, required culmination sequence, or campaign-ending state.
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.5 defines civic and geographic progression but does not define a formal victory trigger, required culmination sequence, or campaign-ending state.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier advancement, Metropolis access, and network participation are progression structures rather than automatic win conditions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tier advancement, Metropolis access, and network participation are progression structures rather than automatic win conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Resources are fungible quantities.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resources are fungible quantities.

atoms.exact_source_text: Items are discrete objects.
atoms.normalized_claim: Items are discrete objects.

atoms.exact_source_text: The distinction governs custody, production, memory, and Away equipment.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Resource/Item distinction governs custody, production, memory, and Away equipment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Resources are counted.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resources are counted.

atoms.exact_source_text: Items are tracked.
atoms.normalized_claim: Items are tracked.

atoms.exact_source_text: Sustenance          | Perishable | Food subject to global Dawn decay
atoms.normalized_claim: Sustenance resource family, Perishable branch, primary character: Food subject to global Dawn decay.

atoms.exact_source_text: Sustenance          | Durable    | Food not subject to routine decay
atoms.normalized_claim: Sustenance resource family, Durable branch, primary character: Food not subject to routine decay.

atoms.exact_source_text: Scrap               | Flexible   | Bendable, fibrous, sheet-like, cord-like, or otherwise yielding material
atoms.normalized_claim: Scrap resource family, Flexible branch, primary character: Bendable, fibrous, sheet-like, cord-like, or otherwise yielding material.

atoms.exact_source_text: Scrap               | Rigid      | Hard, stiff, load-bearing, edged, or structurally resistant material
atoms.normalized_claim: Scrap resource family, Rigid branch, primary character: Hard, stiff, load-bearing, edged, or structurally resistant material.

atoms.exact_source_text: No other universal Resource family is established in v0.5.
atoms.normalized_claim: No other universal Resource family is established in v0.5.

atoms.normalized_claim: Tool is a Permanent functional Item crafted by a Crafter from Resources for Away use.

atoms.exact_source_text: Individually held
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool custody: Individually held.

atoms.exact_source_text: one Tool slot per Citizen
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool custody: one Tool slot per Citizen.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supply   | Consumable functional Item crafted from Resources.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply is a Consumable functional Item crafted from Resources.

atoms.exact_source_text: Remedy Supplies are made by Healer
atoms.normalized_claim: Remedy Supplies are made by Healer.

atoms.exact_source_text: others by Crafter.
atoms.normalized_claim: Non-Remedy Supplies are made by Crafter.

atoms.exact_source_text: Individually carried Away
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply custody: Individually carried Away.

atoms.exact_source_text: anonymous prepared unit
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply custody: anonymous prepared unit.

atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsake is a Permanent personal or historical Item with ownership, provenance, transfer history, location, and meaning.

atoms.exact_source_text: Belongs to a named life
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsake custody: Belongs to a named life.

atoms.exact_source_text: Artifact | Rare singular authored status or exception, usually expressed as a tag on a unique Item.
atoms.normalized_claim: Artifact is a Rare singular authored status or exception, usually expressed as a tag on a unique Item.

atoms.exact_source_text: Individually tracked
atoms.normalized_claim: Artifact custody: Individually tracked.

atoms.exact_source_text: Cargo refers only to Away-carried Resources: Perishable Sustenance, Durable Sustenance, Flexible Scrap, and Rigid Scrap.
atoms.normalized_claim: Cargo refers only to Away-carried Resources: Perishable Sustenance, Durable Sustenance, Flexible Scrap, and Rigid Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: Items are tracked separately and are never Cargo.
atoms.normalized_claim: Items are tracked separately and are never Cargo.

atoms.exact_source_text: Colony Stock is the abstract numerical Home inventory of Resources, visible through Almanac and relevant Project, crafting, and preparation interfaces.
atoms.normalized_claim: Colony Stock is the abstract numerical Home inventory of Resources, visible through Almanac and relevant Project, crafting, and preparation interfaces.

atoms.exact_source_text: No physical Store or warehouse is implied
atoms.normalized_claim: No physical Store or warehouse is implied.

atoms.exact_source_text: “Store” is removed as a defined term.
atoms.normalized_claim: "Store" is removed as a defined term.

atoms.exact_source_text: At Homecoming, Cargo enters Colony Stock.
atoms.normalized_claim: At Homecoming, Cargo enters Colony Stock.

atoms.exact_source_text: Items reconcile separately while retaining holder, owner, location, state, and provenance.
atoms.normalized_claim: Items reconcile separately while retaining holder, owner, location, state, and provenance.

atoms.exact_source_text: At an Outpost Stopover, Cargo may enter Colony Stock through abstract routine transport.
atoms.normalized_claim: At an Outpost Stopover, Cargo may enter Colony Stock through abstract routine transport.

atoms.exact_source_text: There is no second Outpost Stock.
